builds.title: Umber Hulk barricade keeper, monster class 9
builds.difficulty: CR 4 from Table A–51. ECL 9 with 6 class Hit Dice.
traits: Neutral. Natural armor +7, Dexterity +1, Large size −1. Touch 10, flat-footed 16. BAB +4, grapple +14. Fortitude +7, Reflex +3, Will +7. Reach 10 ft.
Alertness, Iron Will, and Ability Focus (Confusing Gaze).
actions: Two claws +9 melee, 1d6+6 each, and a secondary bite +4 melee, 1d8+3, when making a full attack.

Confusing Gaze (Su), 10-ft. range. Will DC 16 negates. On a failure, use confusion for 8 rounds. Resolve passive gaze at the start of each opponent’s turn and one active gaze as an attack action. An opponent averting their eyes has a 50% chance to avoid the save. Covering their eyes avoids the save and gives Rusk total concealment.

Confusion behavior each turn (1d10). On 1 wander away for up to 1 minute without rerolling. On 2–6 do nothing. On 7–9 attack the nearest creature. On 10 act normally. A confused creature that is attacked retaliates on its next turn if it can.
builds.tactics: Rusk listens for footfalls through the rock and burrows to the tunnel mouth. He warns anyone close enough to meet his gaze, then holds the passage with his claws.

builds.title: Air Elemental beacon tender, monster class 5
builds.difficulty: CR 2 from Table A–1. ECL 5 with 4 class Hit Dice.
traits: Neutral. Natural armor +3 and Dexterity +5. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +3, grapple +6. Fortitude +5, Reflex +9, Will +2.
Alertness and Dodge. Dodged opponent faces AC 19 while Skirl can use his Dexterity bonus. Bonus Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, and Weapon Finesse (slam).
Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, and critical hits. Air Mastery imposes −1 on airborne opponents’ attack and damage rolls against Skirl.
actions: Slam +8 melee, 1d6+4 bludgeoning. Flyby Attack allows a partial action, such as the slam, during movement.

Whirlwind (Su), once every 10 minutes for up to 2 rounds. Fly at normal speed in a 5-ft.-wide base and 10- to 30-ft.-high funnel. A Small or smaller creature touching or entering it makes two DC 16 Reflex saves, one to avoid 1d6 damage and one to avoid being lifted. A lifted creature takes 1d6 damage each round and a flyer gets another DC 16 Reflex save each round to escape. Skirl may eject a carried creature at any time. While the base touches the ground, the debris cloud spans half the funnel’s height. It gives concealment at 5 ft., total concealment farther away, and requires a DC 16 Concentration check to cast spells inside.
builds.tactics: Skirl swoops low over the beacon to get attention. If a Small creature rushes the ledge anyway, he uses the whirlwind to pick it up and carry it inland.

builds.title: Imp eavesdropper, monster class 4
builds.difficulty: CR 2 from Table A–29. ECL 4 with 3 class Hit Dice.
traits: Lawful evil. Natural armor +2, Dexterity +4, Tiny size +2. Touch 16, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple −5, reach 0 ft. Fortitude +5, Reflex +7, Will +5.
Poison immunity, fire resistance 5, and damage reduction 5/silver or holy. Alertness, Improved Initiative, and bonus Weapon Finesse (sting).
actions: Sting +9 melee, 1d4 damage. Fortitude DC 15 or take 1d4 Dexterity damage, then a second save one minute later or take another 1d4 Dexterity damage.
Detect good, detect magic, and invisibility at will, caster level 6. Invisibility affects Tack alone, lasts up to 60 minutes or until Tack attacks, and is usable in either form.

Polymorph (Su) at will as a standard action, caster level 12. Tack picked a raven as his only alternate form. He can stay in that form for up to 12 hours under the updated 3.0 polymorph self rules. In that form he has a raven’s 10-ft. land speed and 40-ft. fly speed (average) and loses access to his sting.
builds.tactics: Tack follows a suspect as a raven. As soon as someone bars the shutters, he turns invisible and waits at the door for the next visitor.

builds.title: Rakshasa claims agent, monster class 8
builds.difficulty: CR 6 from Table A–41. ECL 8 with 4 class Hit Dice.
traits: Lawful evil. Dexterity +3. Touch 13, flat-footed 10. BAB +4, grapple +7. Fortitude +7, Reflex +7, Will +5.

Damage reduction 10/+2. Spell immunity covers 1st- through 3rd-level effects and can be suppressed, as for spell resistance, to receive spells. A hit from a blessed crossbow bolt kills Varek. Alertness and Combat Casting.
actions: Two claws +7 melee, 1d4+3 each, and a secondary bite +2 melee, 1d6+1, when making a full attack in natural form.

Alternate Form (Su) at will as a standard action, caster level 18. Use the original alter self rules and choose a humanoid form. Varek can remain disguised indefinitely. His usual disguise is a human clerk.

Detect thoughts (Sp) 3/day, caster level 12, Will DC 15 to hide surface thoughts. Concentrate for up to 12 minutes. The first round detects minds, the second gives their number and Intelligence scores, and the third permits reading surface thoughts.

Sorcerer casting, caster level 4. Daily slots 6/7/4. DC 13 + spell level. Known 0-level spells are detect magic, light, mage hand, message, prestidigitation, and read magic. Known 1st-level spells are charm person, command (cleric spell cast as arcane), and silent image. Known 2nd-level spell is invisibility.

Silent image creates a purely visual illusion for as long as Varek concentrates. Will DC 14 disbelieves on interaction. Invisibility lasts 40 minutes or until the target attacks. Varek must suppress his own immunity to accept it.
builds.tactics: Varek uses detect thoughts to see who recognizes his story. He shows a false cargo hold with silent image. If confronted, he suppresses immunity before turning invisible or sends an associate away under the spell.

concepts.name: Rusk
concepts.motive: Keep the quarry crew out of the abandoned haulage tunnel.
concepts.hook: Rusk taps a warning through the floor, then rises between the crew and the tunnel mouth.

concepts.name: Skirl
concepts.role: Whirlwind controller and cliff beacon tender.
concepts.motive: Keep climbers off a landing where the stone anchors are about to fail.
concepts.hook: Skirl rattles the beacon lanyard three times when the party approaches the wrong ledge.

concepts.name: Tack
concepts.motive: Find the clerk responsible for opening sealed appeals before the hearing.
concepts.hook: The same raven appears outside three shuttered offices. Its footprints lead away from none of them.

concepts.name: Varek Silt
concepts.motive: Recover a manifest before a public hearing links him to the missing cargo.
concepts.hook: Varek arrives as the harbor clerk and offers a sketch of the missing hold. The hold in the sketch was never on the ship.
